capabilities: Import single, multiple, or whole folders of .docx/.docm files as Markdown notes
Convert headings, lists, links, and simple tables to Markdown and complex tables to HTML
Extract embedded images into configurable attachment folders with alt text
Insert converted content into the current note or create new notes
Generate a per-file report of lost, downgraded, and unverifiable content
extras: Desktop-only and requires Obsidian 1.14.4+; the plugin interface is Chinese only; encrypted/password-protected documents and legacy .doc files are unsupported; the manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to bring Word documents in as Markdown while showing what content did not survive the conversion.
summary: Word (.docx/.docm) importer that converts documents to Markdown notes, saves embedded images as attachments, and reports lost or downgraded content.
